Definition: used only in plural the intestines, or (collectively) the abdomen, figuratively, sympathy; by implication, a vest; by extension the stomach, the uterus (or of men, the seat of generation), the heart (figuratively)
BiblicalUsage: 1) internal organs, inward parts, bowels, intestines, belly; 1a) inward parts; 1b) digestive organs; 1c) organs of procreation, womb; 1d) place of emotions or distress or love (fig.); 1e) external belly
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
